unit_label: BRBL C U04: Separate default, NPA classification and the conditions for exercising a remedy

facts.statement: Courseware distinguishes the nonpayment/default framework and asset classification under applicable directions; debt-security demand provisions differ. A defined term does not alone establish every section13 condition.

payload.title: A status label is one input to a legal decision
payload.core_explanation_md:
For the ordinary loan route described in this unit, nonpayment and the applicable non-performing classification matter. An internal overdue label is not a substitute for the asset-classification rules applicable to the lender and account. The courseware also records a distinct debt-security demand branch; do not apply one route mechanically to every instrument.

Even an established NPA does not create missing security, remove exclusions, satisfy notices or prove that every measure was lawful. Keep the definition-level status and the operative enforcement conditions in separate parts of the file. This is a legal-concept lesson, not a certification of a lender current prudential classification instructions.

self_check.prompt_text: Does NPA classification prove that all notices and security conditions have been met?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Those are separate statutory and factual checks.

payload.stem_md: A bank establishes the applicable NPA classification but has not verified whether the proposed asset is charged or excluded. What is the sound next conclusion?

options.text_md: NPA status alone permits seizure of every debtor asset
options.explanation_md: Classification does not create security over uncharged property.

options.text_md: Notices can be skipped because NPA is recorded
options.explanation_md: Applicable notice and process requirements are separate.

options.text_md: Every loan and debt-security demand uses identical definition wording
options.explanation_md: The courseware records distinct branches that require analysis.

options.text_md: Verify the security, exclusions and procedural conditions before selecting the remedy
options.explanation_md: A classification result is one input, not proof of complete enforceability.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A classification result is one input, not proof of complete enforceability.

payload.stem_md: An officer relies on an internal overdue marker as conclusive proof of statutory NPA classification. Which evidence is needed?

options.explanation_md: A marketing label does not establish prudential classification.

options.text_md: The applicable classification directions and account facts supporting the classification
options.explanation_md: The legal definition must be applied to the relevant regulator/lender framework.

options.text_md: The market value of every unrelated borrower asset
options.explanation_md: Collateral value does not alone determine the stated classification.
Renaming a record does not establish the substantive classification.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The legal definition must be applied to the relevant regulator/lender framework.
